query:
UPDATE conversations AS c SET hat_id = $3
           FROM bear_hats AS h
           WHERE c.id = $2 AND c.bear_id = $1 AND c.status = 'active'
             AND h.id = $3 AND h.bear_id = c.bear_id
             AND (c.hat_id = $3 OR (c.hat_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM conversation_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id
             )))
           RETURNING c.hat_id AS "hat_id!: Uuid"
